role: Minimal kernel substrate with distinct early x86_64 bring-up targets
maturity: Early x86_64 kernel bring-up; Multiboot2 and Limine paths remain independent; not a complete OS.

layers.name: Human and operator surface
layers.responsibility: Operator tools, launch UI and diagnostics; not kernel privilege logic.

layers.name: Boot and subsystem contracts
layers.responsibility: Boot handoff, syscall, ABI, image and subsystem data contracts.

layers.name: System orchestration
layers.responsibility: Boot stages, subsystem initialization, admission and coordinated state transitions.

layers.name: Kernel domain
layers.responsibility: Memory, execution, process, synchronization, fault and device models.

layers.name: Privilege and capability policy
layers.responsibility: Address-space, privilege, resource and device-access authorization.

layers.name: Architecture-independent ports
layers.responsibility: CPU, timer, interrupt controller, physical memory, console and device interfaces.

layers.name: Architecture/platform adapters
layers.responsibility: x86_64/E2K or firmware-specific implementations, assembly entry, platform drivers.

layers.name: Memory and persistent state
layers.responsibility: Memory maps, boot metadata, module tables and filesystem/storage state.

layers.name: Boot/runtime and delivery
layers.responsibility: Build/link, image composition, bootloader integration, emulator and deployment.

layers.name: Verification and target evidence
layers.responsibility: Host tests, boot tests, emulation, ABI checks, hardware qualification and logs.

vertical_slices.title: Multiboot2 boot path
vertical_slices.flow: Firmware/bootloader handoff → Multiboot2 validation → x86_64 entry → early allocator/IDT/PIT → serial evidence.

vertical_slices.title: Limine boot path
vertical_slices.flow: Limine image composition → BIOS/UEFI boot → independent kernel entry → QEMU smoke test; do not imply shared allocator/interrupt stack until integrated.

vertical_slices.title: Memory initialization
vertical_slices.flow: Validated memory map → reserve kernel/boot ranges → initialize physical-page bitmap → expose only initialized allocation services.

guardrails: Do not call NUN a complete OS. Scheduler, SMP, ACPI, drivers, VFS, network, userspace and GUI must remain labelled by actual implementation status. Multiboot2 and Limine remain separate paths until explicit integration and regression tests prove otherwise. Host/QEMU success is not physical hardware qualification.
status_note: Architecture mapping only; a planned subsystem is not implemented by its documentation.
